why: With elders, use the careful form with po.

q: In "Nasaan 'yung CR?", 'yung takes the place of…
why: 'yung is the casual word for ang before a noun.
paki- + the English word on: please turn it on.
'yung replaces the ang marker in casual talk: Nasaan 'yung CR?
ayoko takes the linker -ng before the verb: Ayokong umalis.
Ewan ko is the casual "I don't know"; never Ewan ako.
'di is the casual hindi: 'Di ko alam.
Sige means okay, go ahead.
'di ba or 'no at the end asks "right?".
'yung replaces the ang marker in casual talk: Nasaan 'yung jeep?
ayoko takes the linker -ng before the verb: Ayokong kumain.
alam takes the ng form ko: 'Di ko alam.
